english: Everyone, listen up, nyo!\nThis Gamers store\nis being targeted by the Dark Army, nyo!
To defend this place no matter what,\nwe must install interception systems in the store\nand turn it into a fortress, nyo!
So for that, um, I'd like everyone\nto chip in a little war funding…\nhow about it, nyo…?
Um, we don't have\nthis world's money, you know.
Work something out, nyo!\nPawn your treasures or something and raise the cash, nyo!
Okay~ - turns out Dejiko's stingy little fundraiser\nisn't needed!
Usada, you were out on regular patrol!\nWhat's with suddenly coming back, nyo!?
Never mind that, come outside a sec!\nEveryone, come on!
Enemies?
You'll see - hurry!
Not ordinary enemies, then?
Th-this is… Akihabara, nyo!?
See? Told you you'd get it.
It's an even bigger haunted house than Kyouto, desu~!\nWith this many! With this many,\nsurely I can take home ten or a hundred of them, desu~!!
A hundred is a bit much, even…\nThe food costs alone would be no joke.
Nothing's more expensive than free, nyu.
Kyouto was better than this, wasn't it…?
Kyouto seemed to be a region\nfamous for its ghosts,\nso surely there were more of them there…
There's a production region for that!?
We didn't end up in Kyouto because of Polyal's rampage,\ndid we…?
Unfortunately, it's Akihabara, nyu.
That's right.
Where did all of these come from?
Maybe it's a monster nest…?
Even in Akihabara, where you can find anything,\nthere's no such thing, nyo.
So, we just clean these guys up, right?
You're an idiot, nyu.
What'd you say!?
Those things'll just keep coming\nno matter how many you beat, nyu.\nGo after whoever's siccing them on us, nyu.
Oh, right… I-I mean, what!\nI just thought of it a little late!
But I don't see any enemy\nthat looks like a leader?
In that case, we just lure them out.\nLouise, Dejiko - I'm counting on you.
Leave that to me, nyo!
Oh, fine…
Nyo-nyo?\nLook, Louise-san!\nNothing but weak small fry, nyo!
You're right~!\nWho could it be, I wonder - the petty leader\nhiding behind all these numbers!!
That's going too far, the poor thing, nyo!\nThey'll be too embarrassed\nto ever come out, nyo!
Right now it's still before the fighting~,\nso they can still save face, right?
'Now'! It's 'now' or never, nyo!\nOnce the fighting starts it's too late, nyo.
Exactly! If you don't want to be called\nplan-less, useless, and a coward hiding behind small fry,\nyou should come out 'now'!
(Amazing!\nIt's all improv, yet they're perfectly in sync!)
(But isn't the taunting a bit too blatant?)
Nyo-nyo? Nobody's coming out, nyo.\nCould this just be\na bunch of ordinary small fry, nyo?
Maybe they're mixed in with this bunch!\nThey might be so small-time\nwe'd beat them without even noticing?
Ahhahahahaha, nyo~!
Ahhahahahaha!!
(smug)
…I can't stand it, nyo.
Kill 'em, nyu.
We just have to win, right…
They came out, nyo!
It's you guys… figures.
It's a rematch, nyo!
Shut up, nyo!\nIt's your fault my doujinshi got reduced to copy-book handouts -\ntake responsibility, nyo!!
Wiping you out makes us even, nyu.
What an unsightly argument, nyu.
Enough bickering!\nLet's start!
Beat the three dark ones\nand the rest will flee.
Just target those guys, huh?\nLet's do it!
I'll beat you up, nyo!!
…Maybe I should just quit, nyo…
…Nyo?
An Akihabara with no people and no energy\nis lonely, nyo…
Then you shouldn't have\nattacked in the first place, nyo!
If I could, I would, nyu.
Could it be someone's forcing you\ninto this plan?
You can still stop, you know?
…Really?
Hate the sin, not the sinner, nyo.\nIf you're willing to turn over a new leaf,\nI might consider it, nyo.
Then… I'll take you up on that,\nand as proof of starting over,\nI want you to take this, nyo.
Hm? What is it, nyo?
Take this! Eye beams!!
Nyoo!?
Dejiko!?
So naive, nyo…
Too easy, nyu.
Well, it IS Dejiko, after all.
I had a feeling, but\nDejiko acted so simply\nI had no time to stop her.
The trappers and the trapped\nwere both too perfect…
This is no time to be impressed!\nDejiko's in big trouble!!
If I win this battle,\nI'll become Super Soniko…!
Ah…! You're Super Soniko-san!
There are no fans of yours here.\nYou're alone…\nThis time… I win!
I-I know… that even far away,\nthere are people cheering for me!\nSo… I-I won't lose…!
Useless, nyo!\nFrom now on, this Akihabara will become a sanctuary\nonly those chosen by Lady Dark Dejiko may enter, nyo!
What did you say!?
A dark dominion of Dark Dejiko, by Dark Dejiko,\nfor Dark Dejiko!\nI'll build a utopia, nyo!
That's your ambition?
…Hoh… quite the textbook cliché\nmodel villain answer, nyo…!
But you're misunderstanding one thing, nyo.\nAnd that is…
Akihabara is ALREADY a utopia, nyo!
Don't understand what I mean, nyo?\nHeh, that just shows your limits, nyo!
Dejiko!\nYou're acting cool, but are you okay?
Who do you think I am, nyo!\nThe champion of Akihabara - Lady Dejiko, nyo!!
Damage like this,\nI'll fully recover from in one go, nyo!!
H-hey!? That's cheating, nyo!!
Louise's MP recovers when she gets mad, nyo!\nSo I should get some heroine\nplot armor too, nyo!
What's MP, what even is MP…
If you think about it too hard, you lose, nyu.
(As long as Mie doesn't target me…)
Akihabara and Dejiko will never fall, nyo!\nI'll rise again and again, nyo!!
Protecting this irreplaceable otaku utopia\nis MY job, nyo!\nIn everyone's name - punishment time, nyo!!
Kyaa! Dejiko-san is wonderful, desu~!\nFull of 2.5-rate idol vibes!\nI'm swooning, desu~!
Autographs later, nyo!
(That's a slightly dated reference…)
No cheating allowed, nyo!
No sneak attacks allowed, nyo!
Win! Absolutely…!
I can't lose!\nEveryone, lend me your strength!!
I lost… I was supposed to win\nand become Soniko…
Huh, why…?
If only you were gone…!\nI could have lived in this world…\nas Soniko…! Aaaaaaah!
…Sh-she… vanished…?
Was this… part of the shoot too…?
But…
Nico-chan, don't let your guard down yet!
Ah…! Y-yes, sorry!
Th-this wasn't supposed to happen…!
How's that, nyo! Learned your lesson, nyo!
…You thought that's what I'd say, nyo?
Nyo!?
You fell for it completely, nyo!
Gamers takeover: huge success!!
What did you say, nyo!?
So Gamers was their target all along, nyo!
Come to think of it, Mie did say that.
Honestly, neglecting our defenses like that!
You're the one who dragged everyone out\nsaying it was bad and to come look…
Oh? Was that it?
Still, with that many monsters\nscattered through the city,\nwe had no choice but to go crush them.
Exactly, exactly! Jeanne's right!
We have to take Gamers back.
Obviously, nyo!\nIf anything, it saves us\nthe trouble of hunting them down, nyo!
But still - what strategic value\ndoes Gamers even have…?
Because of the Polyal…?
That's the reasonable conclusion.\nConsidering the enemy's defenses,\nour approach…
No - a blitz is the right call here!\nWe charge into Gamers!
Wasn't Jeanne-san the cautious type?
And that's how I kept losing to you.
My caution doesn't have to call\nevery shot for this group.\nIt's enough that it patches up our careless spots.
So now we go like the swift wind!\nReading the subtleties of war like this\nwill itself become the move that wins!
Whoa… she's got presence!\nUntil now I thought she was the sneaky,\nbehind-the-scenes petty type.
Jeanne-san is sooo cool!\nShe's really like\nJeanne d'Arc!
(How about that? Beautiful, isn't she)
(That… even I can see)
I never expected our march\nto lead to Gamers.
You really think a blitz is best?
Yes. There's no doubt this bunch\nisn't the type to win with schemes.\nAnd right now, I'm one of them.
Hmm…
Alright, decided!\nYou're the captain now.
Captain?
I've always thought this group\nwas missing someone to hold it together.\nYou're just right for it, no?
Are you sure? Leave it to me.
Better than leaving it to Dejiko, nyu.
Oh, Puchiko said the right thing.
What'd you say, nyo!?
Jeanne-san has the most battle experience,\nso I think it's a good choice.
I agree.\nShe's calm no matter what -\nisn't she perfect for it?
You'd trust someone who was your enemy until recently?
Um, right now… she's a dear friend…!
There's been a lot going on, but\nwhat matters is what we do now, right?
Well, if Jeanne betrays us,\nI'll smash her to smithereens,\nso relax!
Weren't you also an enemy?
Huh?
D-don't sweat the small stuff!!\nWe're in a hurry, right? Let's go!!
Chris-san went on ahead, desu~.\nCaptain, what shall we do, desu~?
…Understood.
I will answer everyone's trust.\nThen - I'll take command.
From here, we retake Gamers!\nFollowing Yukine Chris - all units, advance!
Yeah!!
//END
